proposedR7Exception.scope: Only the three independently reported P12 release-statement lifecycle blockers: accepted/staged filesystem ACL invariants, statement-independent sealed-set crash-resume validation, and exact three-run exits, plus their existing lifecycle/constructibility test prose and directly conflicting design prose. Only design.md and docs/implementation/phase-execution-packet.md may change.
normativeAmendments: Require the pre-provisioned lock, every canonical and staging ancestor, every staged directory/file, every accepted directory/file, producer-record.json, release-statement.json, raw-result file, and package to have no extended ACL entries.

Use descriptor-based macOS ACL inspection with acl_get_fd_np(fd, ACL_TYPE_EXTENDED) and acl_get_entry; define and fixture-prove the canonical no-ACL sentinel for the pinned macOS version, free returned ACL objects, and fail closed on any entry or unexpected retrieval result.

Before CREATE makes any staged identity, verify the controller-owned staging ancestors and nonce root are ACL-free so no inheritable ACL can reach a child. Verify each newly created entry is ACL-free before content production and again after its final mode; reject rather than sanitize or repair a noncanonical staged or accepted path.
Add ACL state to every descriptor before/after snapshot and to the final canonical-name reopen. Repeat the check after read-only verification tools and before every zero return.

Apply the same ACL-free validation to CREATE install inputs, sealed-set crash resume, REUSE, package-set RENAME_EXCL EEXIST convergence, statement RENAME_EXCL EEXIST convergence, and every validator. An ACL-bearing existing object is REJECT, never absence or repairable state.
Keep unaccepted staging cleanup separate from accepted-state validation; no cleanup job may discover, promote, sanitize, or select release identity.

Define a separate anchored sealed-set validator parameterized by the pinned/local candidate payload; it validates packages, raw results, filesystem properties, statuses, and producer-record fields without requiring a release statement. Only after this validator succeeds may the exclusive statement writer run; full REUSE validation remains statement-dependent.
Exercise the statement-absent sealed-set validator at every safe crash-resume and package-set EEXIST boundary, rejecting partial, ambiguous, or mismatched state without repair.
Require exact first-run exits package:mac=0, collection/qualification=0, verify:release=1, aggregate=1, and exact all-zero exits for runs 2 and 3.

consumedR6Exception.scope: Only the P12 package/release-statement lifecycle, its named tests, and directly conflicting prose; preserve every other R5 invariant and count.
stateMachine: CREATE: when no release statement exists, package:mac builds, signs, notarizes, staples, seals the package set, and invokes the controller-owned exclusive writer exactly once as its final producer step.

REUSE: when the statement exists, package:mac must not rebuild, resign, renotarize, restaple, or invoke the writer; it securely reopens and validates the same immutable package set and statement against externally pinned HEAD and matrix identity, then returns zero only on exact agreement.

REJECT: any invalid statement, package/hash/identity mismatch, partial state, alternate path, link, writable artifact, wrong RC/matrix, or attempted replacement returns nonzero without repair, checkout movement, or new output.
requiredLifecycleProof: Run 1 with no review: package:mac creates once and returns 0; collection succeeds; verify:release returns nonzero because review is absent; aggregate is nonzero.

After a valid independent review is added, the unchanged reporter rerun enters REUSE; package and statement bytes/inodes/hashes remain unchanged; writer invocation count remains one; all child exits and aggregate are zero.
A third identical rerun is also zero and mutation-free, proving idempotent validation rather than a special one-off bypass.
requiredNegativeTests: Missing, replaced, writable, linked, or hash-mismatched package
Wrong RC, matrix digest/revision/path, architecture set, signing identity, or notarization/staple/spctl result
Writer invocation, rebuild, resign, renotarize, restaple, statement replacement, checkout selection, or artifact mutation during REUSE
Concurrent exclusive-create collision that does not resolve to the exact already-valid immutable package/statement identity
